snippet.title: Mouse Work - Trailer 2
snippet.description:
A second look at Nitrome's upcoming Switch 2 game 'Mouse Work' - exclusively controlled with mouse controls!

Here we give you a sneak peak of some previously unseen jobs that will be available in the game, alongside a closer look at some of the jobs we showed in the previous trailer. Other jobs are being kept under wraps for the moment, but we will show more as we draw closer to the game's release!

This trailer also features some of the lovely comments that have been made about Mouse Work following the previous reveal trailer.

Mouse Work is in development for the Nintendo Switch 2. Nitrome are a registered Nintendo developer but at the time of posting do not have access to the development tools required to release on Nintendo Switch 2. All footage shown has been captured on a PC, is not final, and should be considered an approximation of what to expect on final hardware.
